0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000010_ALPHINAUD
0.description: Well, my friends─now that we have all settled back into our bodies, it is time we resumed our duties in earnest. Let us speak of our plans.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000020_THANCRED
1.description: Ever since the Emperor's death, it's been one unsettling rumor after another. I've a mind to pay a visit to Garlemald to ascertain the truth of the matter.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000030_URIANGER
2.description: A prudent endeavor. 'Tis of the essence that we establish the full extent of the threat. Not least if it should prove that Zenos doth indeed orchestrate events from the shadows.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000040_URIANGER
3.description: In light of which possibility, I shall accompany thee on thy mission.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000050_URIANGER
4.description: Be assured that thou shalt find me more a help than a hindrance. Thou requirest another to imbue thine ammunition, dost thou not?

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000051_YSHTOLA
5.description: For DE and FR only. Report if displayed.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000060_ALISAIE
6.description: Assuming that's settled, there's something I've been meaning to look into as well.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000090_LYSE
9.description: You're fine now, right? No more headaches or keeling over?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000100_ALISAIE
10.description: That's right. We're fighting fit, and raring to go!

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000110_GRAHATIA
11.description: The famous Lyse Hext...former Scion and hero of the Ala Mhigan Resistance.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000130_KRILE
13.description: Really? It's so easy to assume that all Archons are acquainted. But then I suppose your fields of expertise <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> rather different.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000140_GRAHATIA
14.description: G'raha Tia, at your service. I have read much and more about your exploits, Commander. It is a pleasure to finally make your acquaintance.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000150_LYSE
15.description: Likewise. The others told me all about you.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000160_ALPHINAUD
16.description: Do not be so sure. Words scarcely do justice to the vital role he played in our victory in the First. A more dependable comrade one would be hard-pressed to find.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000170_LYSE
17.description: Ah, right, I did glance at the report...but I'd be lying if I said I understood half of it.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000180_LYSE
18.description: Well, well...that's a lot to take in. Um... Just to be clear, this means we're <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> heading for another calamity, does it?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000190_URIANGER
19.description: Shorn of their unsundered masters' leadership, what Ascians remain shall struggle to see their plans to fruition.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000200_URIANGER
20.description: And though I would ever advise caution, I believe we may rest easy for a time.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000210_LYSE
21.description: I'll take that as a yes.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000220_LYSE
22.description: Even so, I don't know what to make of this business about Hydaelyn and Zodiark being primals...

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000230_YSHTOLA
23.description: A difficult truth to bear, yes. But at last we understand the nature of our adversary. And if there are no further calamities, neither will there be Rejoinings, meaning Zodiark will never regain His full strength.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000240_YSHTOLA
24.description: Even so, as the oldest and mightiest of primals, He remains a force to be feared.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000250_YSHTOLA
25.description: Though His is a power born of the desire for salvation, we have seen the havoc it may wreak. And it falls to us to ensure that it is never again brought to bear upon this star.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000260_ALPHINAUD
26.description: But tell us, Lyse, to what do we owe the pleasure of your visit?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000270_LYSE
27.description: What do you mean? Isn't seeing my long-lost comrades reason enough? ...All right, there <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> one other matter. I have a message from the Alliance. And before you ask, yes, it's about the Empire.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000280_LYSE
28.description: So, after Emperor Varis's assassination, it seems his cousin “Nerva” made a bid for the throne.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000290_LYSE
29.description: The trouble is, he wasn't the only one with designs on it, and it didn't take long for a civil war to break out. And it's not just in the provinces. Early reports say huge swaths of the imperial capital have been reduced to rubble.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000300_LYSE
30.description: The Alliance will soon convene in Ala Mhigo to decide on a course of action, and we were hoping you'd come along.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000310_THANCRED
31.description: Well! As it happens, Urianger and I were just this moment planning a little trip to Garlemald. And we should be grateful for any advice the Alliance can provide on how best to make the most of our visit.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000330_ALISAIE
33.description: Why don't you go on without me. There's something I need to look into.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000340_ALPHINAUD
34.description: Ah, forgive me, you were just telling us. What is it, if I may ask?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000350_ALISAIE
35.description: I want to find a way to cure the tempered.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000360_ALPHINAUD
36.description: Of course. You think it may be possible to adapt the treatment you used to help those corrupted by the sin eaters...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000370_LYSE
37.description: I'm sorry? A cure for tempering? But that would change everything! Alisaie─consider yourself uninvited. Go and find us this cure!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000390_ALISAIE
39.description: I was hoping you might join me. Don't worry if not, though─I won't hold it against you if you'd rather attend a stuffy meeting.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000410_YSHTOLA
44.description: Rest assured there'll be many, many more. Go on, lend Alisaie a hand.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000420_GRAHATIA
45.description: I'll come too! ...If you don't mind, that is.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000421_YSHTOLA
46.description: For DE and FR only. Report if displayed.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000430_YSHTOLA
47.description: Mind? I'm sure they would be glad of your company. Pray enjoy your time together with your hero.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000440_GRAHATIA
48.description: My...? N-No, that's not─ I mean, I— I-I simply thought my knowledge might be of some use!

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000450_ALPHINAUD
49.description: We shall be on our way, then. Godsspeed.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000460_AYMERIC
50.description: My friend. After the disappointment of not seeing you in Ala Mhigo, what good fortune to chance upon you here of all places.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000470_AYMERIC
51.description: As you may have heard, the allied nations are making a renewed effort to address the primal problem.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000480_AYMERIC
52.description: To that end have I invited the chieftain of the Vanu to Ishgard, that we might together plot a course.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000490_AYMERIC
53.description: Since the war with the Empire appears to be nearing its conclusion, I would also like to call upon Estinien's lance. Alas, he is as ever a difficult man to find.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000500_AYMERIC
54.description: I am informed he recently paid a visit to the Rising Stones. Should he happen to do so again, be sure to pass on my regards, won't you.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000510_AYMERIC
55.description: But tell me, what business brings you to our fair city this day?

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000520_AYMERIC
56.description: A cure for tempering... You never cease to amaze me. Until now, our only hope has been prevention, our every failure irrevocable. But this─this would rewrite the rules of engagement. It could end the cycle of bloodshed...!

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000530_AYMERIC
57.description: Very well. You shall have all the ceruleum we can provide─and an airship with which to transport it.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000540_AYMERIC
58.description: In this matter, you may count on Ishgard's full support.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000550_ALISAIE
59.description: Who would have thought ceruleum weighed so much?

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000560_ALISAIE
60.description: Serves me right for being stubborn, I suppose. I should have just done what you did and accepted help.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000570_CID
61.description: Good work, you two. This is all we asked for and more. Quite a lot more, now that I look at it...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000580_CID
62.description: Lord Aymeric, eh? And entirely by chance? Hah! Some people have all the luck.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000590_GRAHATIA
63.description: We have also succeeded in configuring the terminals─thanks in no small part to our able assistant.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000600_NERO
64.description: It's been a while, hero. You seem surprised to see me. Lest you misunderstand, I've no interest in such things as cures for tempering.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000610_NERO
65.description: But if you mean to achieve that which eluded even the storied Allagans, it seemed plain that you would require my expertise. And so it proved. Is that not right, Garlond?

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000620_CID
66.description: Ask Jessie. She was the one who hired you. All I know is you're an employee of the Ironworks now, so you'll bloody well earn your keep.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000630_CID
67.description: For all the effort it took to track you down after your latest disappearing act, you could find the cure for death and it wouldn't be worth the trouble.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000640_NERO
68.description: Ahem. That wasn't the <hex:021A020203>only<hex:021A020103> reason I agreed to cooperate. I am reliably informed that Garlond and I are destined to unravel the secrets of travel not only across dimensions, but through time.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000650_NERO
69.description: Doubtless the lion's share of the credit lies with me─nine parts to Garlond's one. And this research will be a stepping-stone to that illustrious achievement.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000660_CID
70.description: Very well, then. I'll do a tenth of the work. Just the part that's beyond you.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000680_CID
72.description: By the way, the healing applications of crystal foci proved very useful in getting us to where we are now. I must remember to thank Mikoto.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000690_CID
73.description: Right! If everyone's ready, let's begin!

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000700_CID
74.description: All appears to be in order. Now we just have to wait for it to find us our magick. Why not take this opportunity to put your feet up? This may take a while...

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000720_WEDGE
76.description: Chief! She won't last much longer!

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000730_CID
77.description: We'll have to shut it down!

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000740_GRAHATIA
78.description: Wait! We're close! So very close!

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000770_GRAHATIA
81.description: Please, a moment longer! I beg you!

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000800_GRAHATIA
84.description: I was able to memorize the magick before it faded. It still needs to be put to the proof, but...I believe we have our cure!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000810_WEDGE
85.description: It's just as well. She'll never run again.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000820_GRAHATIA
86.description: The fault is mine. I'm sorry.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000830_CID
87.description: Don't be. It may fall short of dimension-hopping, but a cure for tempering is not to be sniffed at.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000840_CID
88.description: This, my friend, is a world-changing discovery. One we're proud to have had a hand in. A few magitek terminals are a pittance to pay.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000860_CID
90.description: Well, we've done what we can. The rest is up to you.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000880_ALISAIE
92.description: Ga Bu. Have you been good?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000900_MAELSTROMOFFICER
94.description: Still no change, I'm afraid. He just stands there in silence until we move him.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000910_ALISAIE
95.description: It's all right now. We're going to help you get better.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000930_ALISAIE
97.description: Alphinaud! Y'shtola! I thought you were attending to primal matters.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000940_YSHTOLA
98.description: We were, and came here for a meeting on the subject. Certain pirate factions did not deign to attend, however, and it was canceled.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000950_ALPHINAUD
99.description: We had resigned ourselves to having wasted a journey when we chanced to espy you.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000960_ALPHINAUD
100.description: Could it be that there has been progress with the treatment?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000970_ALPHINAUD
101.description: Using magitek terminals to formulate the solution... I would never have contemplated such an approach.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000980_YSHTOLA
102.description: So this new magick, adapted from memory transference, would be used to purge the subject of their fanatical faith, while Angelo would be responsible for reanimating the aether of their soul... Hm.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_000990_YSHTOLA
103.description: Yet I wonder at the practicalities. If one were to reanimate the soul first, it would only serve to exacerbate the tempering. Conversely, a stagnant soul would not respond to the effects of the magick.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001000_YSHTOLA
104.description: Would both need to be performed simultaneously?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001010_GRAHATIA
105.description: Nothing escapes Master Matoya's inquiring eye! As you say, both must be carried out simultaneously, and thus I propose to imbue Angelo with the tempering treatment in much the same manner as I did the spirit vessels.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001020_ALISAIE
106.description: By doing so, we also spare G'raha the trouble of casting spell after spell. It's really rather efficient.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001030_GRAHATIA
107.description: Be that as it may, certain difficulties are unavoidable: the imbuing process will still require no small amount of aether.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001040_GRAHATIA
108.description: And as I can no longer draw upon the Crystal Tower's stores of energy, I will be compelled to rely on those of others.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001050_ALPHINAUD
109.description: Well, I for one would be glad to assist.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001060_YSHTOLA
110.description: As would I. Since the resumption of our duties, it has been naught but stuffy meetings, and I have ample aether to spare.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001070_GRAHATIA
111.description: Excellent. With your permission, then, let us begin.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001120_GRAHATIA
116.description: Well...we seek to go where even the Allagans did not. It was never like to be easy.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001130_GRAHATIA
117.description: The rest is up to you, Alisaie. The treatment itself will take time and focus, so we will need a quiet room. I'm sure our hosts can spare one.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001140_GRAHATIA
118.description: I will go with her. It may be a while before we return, so I would ask for your patience...and your faith.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001150_ALISAIE
119.description: We'll bring Ga Bu back. You see if we don't!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001160_ALPHINAUD
120.description: 'Twould seem our part is played. Let us find a place to recuperate while we wait for news.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001170_ALPHINAUD
121.description: For years, Eorzea has labored to find a solution to the primal problem, without success. Any hope that tempering could be reversed faded long ago.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001180_ALPHINAUD
122.description: I myself had given it up as impossible─given up on the tempered and the Light-corrupted alike. They were problems to be tolerated, or else eliminated, I believed, and to think otherwise was pure naivety. Childishness, even.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001190_ALPHINAUD
123.description: But Alisaie refused to give up. She struggled, and she struggled...and her efforts were rewarded with a way to bring back Halric. And now countless others may no longer be beyond salvation.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001200_ALPHINAUD
124.description: However much we bicker, I have the greatest respect for my sister. Had I half her stubbornness─nay, her <hex:021A020203>unwillingness<hex:021A020103> to accept the status quo, I would be a far better person. A far better Scion.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
126.description: Well, if it's any consolation, she's in awe of your work.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001210_ALPHINAUD
128.description: She told you of my graduation thesis? How very...embarrassing.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001220_ALPHINAUD
129.description: Nonetheless, it is comforting─and not a little surprising─to hear that I'm still capable of impressing my sister. On the rare occasions I'm not annoying her, that is.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001230_ALPHINAUD
130.description: I should, I know. Yet despite my good intent, I have the feeling that I would only succeed in incurring her ire.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001260_GABU
133.description: I'm so glad to see you all! Delighted, happy, glad!

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001280_GABU
135.description: All this time, my mind was filled with thoughts of Great Father Titan.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001290_GABU
136.description: But I never forgot about Mother and Father. Always, they were in my heart. Constantly, ever, always.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001300_GABU
137.description: So I tried to focus on their faces. Theirs and yours. Alisaie's and everyone's. And I found that I could remember. One thing, then another, and another!

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001310_GRAHATIA
138.description: Your hopes reached Ga Bu. They helped him to hold on.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001320_ALISAIE
139.description: I'm so proud of you, Ga Bu.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001330_GABU
140.description: I couldn't have done it without you, Alisaie. Can you help the others too? Cure them, heal them, help them?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001340_ALISAIE
141.description: Yes. We can. All of them.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001350_GRAHATIA
142.description: Without wishing to dampen the mood, I feel compelled to add certain caveats regarding the viability of the treatment for general use.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001360_GRAHATIA
143.description: As you know, reversing the effects of tempering demands a profuse amount of aether. And while Alisaie was able to heal Ga Bu alone, I fear the same will not be true for those who exhibit more advanced symptoms.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001370_GRAHATIA
144.description: Moreover, the treatment's effects are limited to the soul. It offers no succor to those whose very flesh has been altered through prolonged exposure to a primal's influence.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001380_GRAHATIA
145.description: All of which is to say that we cannot save everyone.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001390_ALISAIE
146.description: Maybe we can't. Or maybe we can. No one gave us a hope of saving Ga Bu, and yet here we are. We must find a way to treat as many as possible.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001400_ALPHINAUD
147.description: Then...the next logical step would be to produce a veritable army of porxies, would it not? Granted, it seemed a simple enough process in the First, but I suspect it will be different here in the Source. Not that I am any authority, of course...

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001410_YSHTOLA
148.description: Yet there <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> an authority on familiars to whom we may grudgingly turn. She's stubborn, haughty, eccentric, irascible, laconic, annoying─and her name is Master Matoya. The real one.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001420_ALISAIE
149.description: I have to go now, Ga Bu, but the people here will look after you, all right? And I promise to come and visit you again soon.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001430_GABU
150.description: All right! Thank you, Alisaie! Thank you!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001440_MATOYA
151.description: Nary a word from you all this time, then you bring every man and his poroggo with you. Did no one teach you any manners, girl?

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001450_YSHTOLA
152.description: They were too busy teaching me aetherology, Master. Jesting aside, I wanted to be the one to express our gratitude.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001460_YSHTOLA
153.description: I am told you spared no effort to sustain our bodies while we were away. And for that we owe you our lives. Thank you.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001470_MATOYA
154.description: Hmph. You were gone so long, I was starting to think you'd set your heart on staying.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001480_YSHTOLA
155.description: It wasn't easy to leave, as it happens. Seldom does one have the opportunity to study other worlds, and I would not have minded extending my stay by a handful of years.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001490_ALPHINAUD
156.description: Ever the scholar, Y'shtola dedicated herself to studying ancient civilizations of the First, befriending a tribe known as the Night's Blessed in the process. There, she took on the name of Matoya, and won the respect of all the children of the forest.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001500_YSHTOLA
157.description: I merely adopted an alias in accordance with the custom of my hosts. Yours just happened to be the first name that came to mind.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001510_MATOYA
158.description: You mean to tell me you went gallivanting about using my name, and only bother to visit when you need a favor? And don't pretend you don't! I taught you long enough.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001520_YSHTOLA
159.description: Indeed. And devoted pupil that I am, I could not fail to recall my master's sage advice: “When the answer eludes you, look to the wisdom of your elders.”

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001530_MATOYA
160.description: You there─were you going to introduce yourself?

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001540_GRAHATIA
161.description: How remiss of me. G'raha Tia is my name, and I am proud to call myself a Scion.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001550_GRAHATIA
162.description: I too wish to offer my gratitude for your invaluable aid in sustaining the Archons' bodies...as well as my apologies. It was my inexpert summoning spell which endangered their lives in the first place.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001560_MATOYA
163.description: Ah, yes, the one bent on digging up the mysteries of Allag. Old Galuf used to speak of you, and Krile's told me all about your recent exploits.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001570_MATOYA
164.description: Do you have a bad back, or something? At ease, boy! Whatever mess you've made, I'm not in the habit of dwelling on the failings of the younger generation.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001580_GRAHATIA
165.description: ...You are too kind. I have also heard much and more about you, Master Matoya. 'Tis an honor to finally make your acquaintance.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001590_MATOYA
166.description: Well, that's more than enough pleasantries for anyone. Tell me what you want. I haven't got all day.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001600_MATOYA
167.description: ...So that's the way of it. It should be a simple enough matter to make the familiar. The magick, on the other hand...

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001610_GRAHATIA
168.description: Ah, that you may leave to me. Being the only one possessed of royal blood, I alone can imbue the subject with the necessary magick.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001620_MATOYA
169.description: So I just need to create porxies with the power to stir the soul.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001630_MATOYA
170.description: “Just,” I say, though we're talking about a veritable herd of the little buggers. We'd collapse before we reached double figures.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001640_MATOYA
171.description: But if I could get a <hex:021A020203>familiar<hex:021A020103> to create the familiars─a mother porxie, as it were...

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001650_MATOYA
172.description: It seems I haven't seen the last of that moldy old hole after all...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001660_MATOYA
173.description: Right. To begin with, I need you to gather a few ingredients.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001670_MATOYA
174.description: Listen well to what the poroggos say. Or you'll wish you had.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001680_MATOYA
175.description: Right then! Let's get this over with!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001690_MATOYA
176.description: Newborns are wont to be difficult! Show her who's in charge!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001710_GRAHATIA
178.description: Then all that remains is for me to imbue her with the magick. My friends, I'm afraid I must trouble you for your aether once more.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001730_MATOYA
180.description: Good. Let's set her to work then, shall we? I want to see some porxies. Assuming, that is, someone can spare the requisite energy?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001740_MATOYA
181.description: A mere drop in the ocean for the great sorceress Matoya, I daresay.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001750_MATOYA
182.description: Excellent. Our very own litter of Angelos.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001760_MATOYA
183.description: And we can make as many more as we want simply by providing the mother porxie with additional aether.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001770_YSHTOLA
184.description: I will require a moment before I try again.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001780_ALISAIE
185.description: It's still hard work, but a damn sight more efficient than making them one by one. Thank you, Master Matoya. Everyone. We're a step closer to our goal.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001790_ALPHINAUD
186.description: Distributed amongst the allied nations, they should do much to facilitate closer dialogue with the beast tribes. And given their present travails, I believe our friends in Limsa Lominsa should be the first beneficiaries.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001800_YSHTOLA
187.description: Agreed. Though I must leave this errand to you. I doubt my legs will carry me out of the cave, much less to Vylbrand.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001810_YSHTOLA
188.description: Thank you for taking the lead in gathering the ingredients. I expect you would benefit from a rest too.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001820_MATOYA
189.description: In addition to the porxies, I trust you've gained an inkling of how much effort goes into the creation of familiars. Or mayhap you attribute your struggles to old age?

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001830_YSHTOLA
190.description: If I said yes, would it persuade you to treat me like an adult?

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001840_MATOYA
191.description: Hmph! Not with that pertness, it wouldn't. Anyway, assuming you have no other favors to ask, I shall be leaving.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001880_SICARD
195.description: Welcome aboard, Admiral. I'll wager you don't remember me. Sicard, actin' captain of the Bloody Executioners, at your service.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001890_MERLWYB
196.description: 'Twas kind of you to invite us. Now, if Captain Hyllfyr has a message for me, I bid you speak it.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001900_SICARD
197.description: <hex:021A020203>We<hex:021A020103> have just the one demand: that you forget this bilge about makin' peace with the beastmen.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001910_SICARD
198.description: Ours is a nation of pirates. Always has been, always will be. Deny us our right to plunder and you deny who we are!

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001950_MERLWYB
202.description: Piracy has no place in our future.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001980_MERLWYB
205.description: Our nation has prospered through piracy, 'tis true. Yet it is but one part of our long and storied history.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_001990_MERLWYB
206.description: Centuries ago, our ancestors led a failed rebellion, and were driven from their homes with little more than the shirts on their backs. In fear of their lives, they sailed south, until they came to these shores.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002000_MERLWYB
207.description: Finding the land occupied by kobolds, however, they were forced to turn to piracy in order to survive. And survive they did.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002010_MERLWYB
208.description: But not so long ago, when the Empire threatened to crush everything we'd built, we set aside piracy and joined hands with our neighbors. This, too, was in order to survive.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002020_MERLWYB
209.description: And survive we did. Time after time we fought the Empire, and time after time we won. And through trade with our newfound allies, we prospered more than we ever did through pillaging and plundering!

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002030_MERLWYB
210.description: The Empire teeters on the brink of collapse. Ere long, provinces like Werlyt and Bozja and many others will regain their freedom.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002040_MERLWYB
211.description: When they do, our matchless fleet will lead the world in a new golden age of commerce. The tides favor us, and the ocean beckons with her vast bounty...

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002050_MERLWYB
212.description: But if we cling to the old ways, this great ship we call Limsa will trade the boundless seas for a lagoon! Shall we scorn the world's wealth for a plundered pittance, then?

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002060_MERLWYB
213.description: Or shall we embrace change and thrive, like our ancestors before us? The choice is yours. But if we are to prosper in the coming age, the whole of Vylbrand must become our ship, and the kobold and Sahagin our crewmates!

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002070_SICARD
214.description: Rousin' words. Might even be some truth in 'em. But piratin's all we've ever known, and we ain't about to give it up just 'cause you say so!

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002080_SICARD
215.description: Still, we're all Lominsans here, an' no one wants a war. So where does that leave us?

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002090_SICARD
216.description: Long before you became Admiral, I heard you was captain of the League o' Lost Bastards. That true?

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002100_SICARD
217.description: If so, you'd know how we pirates settle our differences.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002120_MERLWYB
219.description: Very well. As Admiral of Limsa Lominsa, I accept your challenge.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002130_SICARD
221.description: This ain't over! Not till one of us is dead! Finish the job...or <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> will!

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002160_HYLLFYR
224.description: Ye fool. 'Twas over afore it began.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002180_HYLLFYR
226.description: Seems the whelps've been yappin' while their master was abed.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002190_HYLLFYR
227.description: Listen well, all o' ye. Since the signin' o' the Galadion Accord, we all of us've been part o' the same crew─the crew o' the good ship Limsa Lominsa.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002200_HYLLFYR
228.description: At the helm o' that ship is the Admiral, an' 'tis <hex:021A020203>she<hex:021A020103> who decides where we sail. Was I not clear on that point? Or did ye forget whose deck ye stand on? Nay?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002210_HYLLFYR
229.description: Then what in the seven 'ells're ye playin' at!?

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002220_SICARD
230.description: It's all we know, Captain. If we ain't pirates, what are we?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002230_HYLLFYR
231.description: Yer bloody idiots, is what you are! Idiots with yer whole lives ahead o' ye! Ye can do anythin' ye want─be anythin' ye want!

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002240_HYLLFYR
232.description: We're pirates, aye... An' we pirates love our loot. But that ain't our first love. Our first love is the sea, the sea an' what she brings us─freedom.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002250_HYLLFYR
233.description: So 'old fast to that. Let the brine-crusted 'usk that stands before ye now be the last o' them as knew naught save 'ow to steal, an' make o' yerselves a <hex:021A020203>new<hex:021A020103> breed o' pirate!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002260_HYLLFYR
234.description: Lad... I made ye me right hand 'cause I saw somethin' in ye. An' I still do. Ye've the makin's of a captain. All you lack's the belief.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002270_HYLLFYR
235.description: Well now! It seems we're of one mind after all! Apologies for the misunderstanding, Admiral. We're with ye, wherever ye be headed.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002300_HYLLFYR
238.description: Yer choice o' duelin' pistol did not escape my notice. Good old Annihilator, ender o' many a proud pirate's voyage.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002310_HYLLFYR
239.description: Mistbeard's vanished into legend, an' it won't be long afore I take my rest in the depths. Yet be that as it may, the old ways can only truly die when we've dealt the Empire the tellin' blow.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002320_HYLLFYR
240.description: There'll be stormy seas ahead, no doubt...but I'm trustin' ye to steer us through to the other side.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002330_MERLWYB
241.description: Greetings, Patriarch. I am Merlwyb Bloefhiswyn, Admiral of Limsa Lominsa.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002340_MERLWYB
242.description: I come before you to offer my sincerest apologies for the many wrongs committed by my people against you and yours.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002350_ZADA
243.description: Hehehehe... You were foolish to come here. Stupid, unwise, foolish.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002360_ZADA
244.description: The Great Father shall have your souls for your folly!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002390_ALISAIE
247.description: You don't need to tell me!

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002400_GRAHATIA
248.description: Let none pass! We must grant her as much time as we can!

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002405_ALISAIE
249.description: Yes, this will do! Here I go!

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002440_ZADA
253.description: What is the meaning of this!?

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002450_ALISAIE
254.description: I'm sorry...but they died by your hand. You sacrificed them to summon Titan.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002470_ZADA
256.description: Why? Why would I do such a thing?

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002480_GRAHATIA
257.description: Would that there were a cure for the victims of the tempered...

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002490_ALISAIE
258.description: Ga Bu! What are you doing here?

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002500_GABU
259.description: Patriarch. Please listen to me. Hear, heed, listen.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002510_GABU
260.description: The Great Father we have been summoning is false. He only hurts us and those we love.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002520_GABU
261.description: For a long time, His voice filled my mind. It told me to do terrible things. Awful, unspeakable, terrible things.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002530_GABU
262.description: But I didn't give in to it. And you mustn't either.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002540_GABU
263.description: There's been too much pain already. So please, end the suffering.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002560_MERLWYB
265.description: We share this child's desire, Patriarch. An end to summoning. For it spells naught but misery for both our peoples.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002570_MERLWYB
266.description: For many long years, man and kobold have feuded over territory, pillaging and perishing for the earth beneath our feet.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002580_MERLWYB
267.description: It may be said that we fought to survive, but what we have sown in blood, we have reaped in suffering, and it cannot go on. I would see us set aside the past and work together for peace.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002590_ZADA
268.description: It was wrong of me to hurt my own in the name of the Great Father. Sinful, evil, wrong. But that doesn't mean there can be peace between us.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002600_ZADA
269.description: Men cannot be trusted! The bounty of the land was to be ours, and yours the bounty of the sea! But you broke the pact! Violated, breached, broke!

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002610_ZADA
270.description: Unready as we were, what choice had we but to call upon the divine to rid ourselves of your tyranny?

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002620_MERLWYB
271.description: None. And I do not blame you for it.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002630_MERLWYB
272.description: In violation of the spirit─if not the letter─of the pact, we took your lands for our own. The fault lies wholly with us.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002640_MERLWYB
273.description: On behalf of all Lominsans, I offer you my humblest apology. I pray you will find it in your heart to accept it.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002650_MERLWYB
274.description: Yet I know an apology alone will not serve to make things right. So we will revise the pact to leave no room for doubt, and any who violate it shall face justice swift and certain.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002660_ZADA
275.description: No! We won't be fooled! Not again!

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002670_MERLWYB
276.description: Please, hear me to the end. Fleeting though it was, there was a time when man and kobold abided together in harmony. In cooperation.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002680_MERLWYB
277.description: In those days, your people shared the secrets of smelting─knowledge which allowed Limsa Lominsa to thrive. Much of what we have, we owe to the kobolds.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002690_MERLWYB
278.description: And so, for the good of all who dwell on this isle, I wish to make you an offer. We will bear your people's wares to every corner of the world, and trade them in your stead.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002700_MERLWYB
279.description: In return, we will bring you the bounty not only of the sea, but lands both near and far. Whatever you desire, the Navigator as my witness, you shall have it.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002710_MERLWYB
280.description: There will be no more man and beastman─just the crew of the great ship that is Vylbrand. And together, we will share in the wealth of the world─if you will only accept our hand in friendship.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002720_ZADA
281.description: We want to believe you! We truly do! But we believed you before, and you betrayed us! Fooled, deceived, betrayed us!

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002730_GABU
282.description: There are bad men, it's true, but there are also good ones. And the ones before you are the best of them. They were always kind to me─caring, nice, kind─and I trust them with my life.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002740_MERLWYB
283.description: Before I became Admiral, I was a pirate. I stole. I fought. I stained the sea red with blood. Such is my past, and I dare not forget it, however much I might want to.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002750_MERLWYB
284.description: That is Death Penalty. The pistol I used to pass judgment on my own sire when he fell thrall to Leviathan and betrayed his comrades.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002760_MERLWYB
285.description: It is loaded. If you were to point it at my head and pull the trigger, I would most assuredly die.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002770_MERLWYB
286.description: Though it isn't much, my life is the single most valuable thing I possess. If it will suffice to atone for past wrongs─take it.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002780_MERLWYB
287.description: A single bullet to annul the old pact, and my blood to write it anew.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002790_MERLWYB
288.description: What comes after, I entrust to this man, my second-in-command. I know that he will do his utmost for the happiness of all who call Vylbrand home.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002800_ZADA
289.description: I do not trust you. Not yet. But Ga Bu does. And I will trust him.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002810_ALISAIE
290.description: We want you to know that we respect your faith. There's nothing wrong with giving thanks to the land which sustains you.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002820_ALISAIE
291.description: But summoning is different. Should you hear of anyone who would attempt it, we ask that you appeal to their better judgment, or failing that, seek our aid. We're always ready to help.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002830_ZADA
292.description: Many and more of my brethren are yet in thrall to the Great Father, just as I was. If you could free them too, I would be grateful. Appreciative, thankful, grateful.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002840_MERLWYB
293.description: 'Tis we who should be grateful, Patriarch. I thank you for affording us this chance.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002850_ALPHINAUD
294.description: Right, let's return to the Rising Stones.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002860_STORMOFFICER
295.description: Admiral! Something strange is afoot at the Floating City!

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002880_STORMOFFICER
297.description: I think it's best you see for yourself. Please come with me.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002890_ALPHINAUD
298.description: What in the world is that?

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002910_STORMOFFICER
300.description: You can see it too, then? I feared I was losing my wits. One moment I was patrolling as usual, and the next, it was just...there.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002920_MERLWYB
301.description: Yes? This is she... I am... Aye. I'm looking at it.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002930_MERLWYB
302.description: What!? Understood... Send the Elder Seedseer my regards.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002940_MERLWYB
303.description: The communications officer. It seems this isn't the only tower. They've sprung up all across Eorzea.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002950_MERLWYB
304.description: Nothing more is known─only that they appear to be of Garlean construction. Our allies on the Ala Mhigan front are on highest alert.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002960_MERLWYB
305.description: Forgive my directness─but would you join them? They may well need the help.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002970_ALPHINAUD
306.description: Of course, Admiral. We shall make all haste.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002980_MERLWYB
307.description: My thanks. I will return to Limsa to weigh our response.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_002990_MERLWYB
308.description: Look for Commander Hext when you arrive in Ala Mhigo. And may the Navigator speed you on your way!

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003000_LYSE
309.description: Thank you for coming so soon.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003010_LYSE
310.description: I'll send for Commander Aldynn at once, and we can decide what to do about these infernal towers.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003060_FANDANIEL
315.description: Well, well, well, to be received by such an illustrious cast! Why, even the hero of the piece is here! I feel quite starstruck!

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003080_ALISAIE
317.description: His body, more like. You don't fool us!

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003090_FANDANIEL
318.description: You saw straight through it... Anyone would think you'd dealt with Ascians before!

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003100_FANDANIEL
319.description: Permit me to introduce myself. I am Fandaniel, and may I say what a pleasure it is to finally make your acquaintance.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003110_FANDANIEL
323.description: My, straight to business, is it? Suit yourself...

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003120_FANDANIEL
324.description: It is my intention to recreate the Final Days, to which end I have distributed a collection of rather ingenious devices─or “towers”─which will, in time, give rise to the grandest of spectacles!

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003130_ALPHINAUD
325.description: The Final Days...? But it was the Ascians who labored to prevent them!

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003140_FANDANIEL
326.description: You're quite right! Though I would expect no less from one responsible for eliminating my unsundered colleagues.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003150_FANDANIEL
327.description: Honestly, the three of them were <hex:021A020203>obsessed<hex:021A020103> with restoring the one true world. As a sovereign individual, however, I never had much interest in such things. I mean, why bother when you're just another sundered minion?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003160_FANDANIEL
328.description: Admittedly, Elidibus was not convinced by that argument. But thanks to you, I'm finally free of his incessant nagging!

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003170_FANDANIEL
329.description: Free to use my powers as I see fit! To fulfill my heart's desire!

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003180_FANDANIEL
330.description: And my heart's desire is to lay this half-broken world to waste, leaving nary a fleck of dust behind!

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003190_ALISAIE
331.description: What!? Why would you want such a thing!?

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003200_FANDANIEL
332.description: Because I want wretched creatures who ask such meaningless questions to die!

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003220_FANDANIEL
337.description: And I want to die too! Oh yes, I want to die and take everyone with me in a paroxysm of pain and suffering!

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003230_FANDANIEL
338.description: I'm different, you see. From the ancients who clung to dear life. And from you.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003240_FANDANIEL
339.description: So don't bother trying to reason with me. You will find I have no reason. Or creed. Or any such tripe.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003250_FANDANIEL
340.description: I just want to destroy the world. But please <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> resist with all your might. It will add to my enjoyment.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003260_FANDANIEL
341.description: Now then, ladies and gentlemen! Keep your eyes peeled, for the curtains have risen on the spectacle to end all spectacles!

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003270_FANDANIEL
342.description: We, the Telophoroi, shall be your performers, and this very star our stage!

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003280_FANDANIEL
343.description: Ah, but I nearly forgot! I have a message for you. Ahem! My esteemed patron, Lord Zenos, eagerly awaits you at the heart of the chaos.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003290_FANDANIEL
344.description: While I wish only to destroy the world, he exists solely to relive a certain...transcendent moment with you, and it is for <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> reason he would reduce all to ash.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003300_FANDANIEL
345.description: Pray see to it his dreams do not go unfulfilled. For if you should disappoint him...

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003310_FANDANIEL
346.description: My trusty companion here─whom I've dubbed “Lunar Bahamut”─will burn your cities and everyone in them.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003320_RAUBAHN
347.description: Everyone out. My men will tend to the blaze.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003340_LYSE
349.description: The scouts should've been back by now. I'm going to go and find them.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003360_RESISTANCEWARRIOR
351.description: Glory be... Glory be... Glory be...

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003390_FANDANIEL
354.description: The piles have been driven as planned, and the first of the beasts has roared to life.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003400_FANDANIEL
355.description: Moreover, I am pleased to report that preparations are well underway for the rest. Ere long, chaos shall reign over all the land─as befits the Final Days.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003410_ZENOS
356.description: Call it what you will. So long as my friend returns to me, fangs bared and claws sharpened, I care not.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003420_FANDANIEL
357.description: Of course, my lord. By strange coincidence, your dear friend chanced to be present when I made my declaration.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003430_FANDANIEL
358.description: I took the liberty of informing <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> that you await <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> coming. Though, I confess, I may have singed <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> a little in the process.

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003440_ZENOS
359.description: And why do you tell me this? Are you in such a hurry to die?

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003450_FANDANIEL
360.description: Ah, my apologies. I must guard my tongue lest it be the end of me.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003460_FANDANIEL
361.description: Though...there is something to be said for such a glorious death. Better to fall to one who <hex:021A020203>has it all<hex:021A020103> than falter before an inferior... I shall keep it in mind as a contingency.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003470_FANDANIEL
362.description: For now, however, I shall proceed with the plan. My lord.

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05400_003480_ZENOS
363.description: I must find myself a new weapon. One worthy of our long-awaited reunion.
